en.headline: HKMA consults on next phase of sustainable finance taxonomy
en.dek: The Monetary Authority's Phase 2B prototype expands the list of defined green and transition activities from 25 to 39 and adds shoreline and flood measures, with comments due by 7 October.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority on Monday opened a one-month public consultation on the Phase 2B prototype of the Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance, which sets definitions for green and transition activities used in market decisions.

The prototype adds 10 economic activities and recategorises some from Phase 2A, lifting the total from 25 to 39. The authority said the update covers enabling technologies such as battery manufacturing and recycling and low-carbon technology manufacturing, and sets transition pathways for harder-to-abate sectors including aviation and steel.

On climate adaptation, the prototype introduces a process-based assessment and 24 measures — 11 on a whitelist and 13 off it — with an initial focus on shoreline protection and flood management, which the HKMA said are closely tied to Hong Kong's main climate risks.

The consultation runs until 7 October 2026. An HKMA assistant chief executive said the Phase 2B taxonomy is expected to be finalised around the end of this year or early next year, after which the authority plans to collect banks' usage data in a more systematic way.

zh.headline: 金管局就可持續金融分類目錄第2B階段諮詢
zh.dek: 金管局公布第2B階段原型，將綠色及轉型經濟活動由25項增至39項，並加入海岸及防洪適應措施，公眾可於10月7日前提交意見。
body: 香港金融管理局周一就《香港可持續金融分類目錄》第2B階段原型展開為期一個月的公眾諮詢。分類目錄旨在為綠色及可持續活動提供清晰定義，方便市場作融資決定，並減少漂綠疑慮。
原型新增10項經濟活動，並調整第2A階段部分分類，令涵蓋活動由25項增至39項。金管局表示，新階段加入電池製造及回收、低碳技術製造等賦能科技，並為航空及鋼鐵等較難減排的行業訂立轉型路徑。
適應氣候變化方面，原型引入以程序為本的評估方法，新增24項適應措施，包括11項白名單及13項非白名單措施，先聚焦海岸管理及防洪，金管局指兩者與香港主要氣候風險相關。
諮詢期至2026年10月7日。金管局助理總裁表示，預料第2B階段分類目錄於今年底或明年初正式推出，其後會更有系統地收集銀行使用情況。
